capabilities: Chat with the current note, selection, and referenced or pasted images
Translate, explain, polish, expand, or summarize selected text
Format notes via AI modes or prompt templates with diff review before applying
Save anchored annotations, thoughts, and TODOs outside the note body
Organize images, archive orphan attachments, generate metadata, and sort an inbox
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not just a note organizer; it also provides chat, selection rewrites, translation, AI formatting, and image understanding.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese) and API keys are stored unencrypted in plugin data; annotation records live in plugin data and need syncing across devices.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance for translating, rewriting, formatting, or organizing notes using the current note and its images as context.
